mutants.name: restore-all-integer-imports
mutants.rationale: Existing acceptance checks only that at least two functions and macros remain, allowing accidental widening of imports.

replacements.after:
context.env
              |> Map.update!(:functions, &Keyword.put(&1, Integer, Integer.__info__(:functions)))
              |> Map.update!(:macros, &Keyword.put(&1, Integer, Integer.__info__(:macros)))
              |> prune_env(%Evaluator.Tracer{})

mutants.name: retain-failed-process-dictionary
mutants.rationale: Failed-cell writes and deletion must not become the next context.
